hk55.text: Conclusion: you have just shown me your soft, meatbag-like underbellies and said, HK-47, please shoot me repeatedly there until I die.

jarvis.text: Oh, good day, sir. I hope you are well today. We have visitors.

cortana.text: A dozen Covenant superior battleships against a single Halcyon class cruiser. According to my analysis of the available data, I believe the best course of action is somewhat risky.

vince_noir.text: I love hanging out with Ferry. We used to go hunting, fishing. We lived in a small house made out of bus tickets.

prinnies.text: Lord Valvatorez, all of the Prinnies have been gathered! Please come to the Prinny Factory!

roll_casket.text: Megaman, can you hear me? The Mayor says there is something real important she has to talk with you.

lain.text: Okay, let us see. I guess that I am confused again. Am I here or am I there? I do not know. Over there, I am everywhere.

adjutant.text: Add on, complete. Our allies base is under attack. Our allies are being attacked.

paimon.text: Hello, my name is Paimon. Oh, Paimon already learned some unique conversation!
